anya (AE): EuroFin follow-up: they want a 2-week POC. Requirements: Go streaming client, function-calling JSON, EU-only data, short-lived creds, and a cheaper quantized model. Thoughts?

samir (SE): All doable but KMS+short-lived creds require Dedicated/Private. Hosted EU covers residency but only supports scoped API keys and IP allowlist.

kevin (Solutions Eng): Go SDK stream example: connect to wss://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood/quant-4bit and include functions array in the initial payload. Buffer frames until "function_call_end" then parse JSON. I'll paste helper snippets in the ticket.

lucy (SRE): Compliance notes: EuroFin needs SOC2 and 12mo audit logs. Dedicated gives KMS/HSM integration and STS token exchange. Hosted + customer sidecar is a hybrid but not certified for KMS.

anya (AE): Pricing: they expect rough ballpark. 50k MAU read pattern, 40 tokens/req. Any back-of-envelope?

samir (SE): ~2M tokens/month. Hosted quant example pricing ~$0.0015 per 1k tokens => ~$3k/month compute; Dedicated shifts to fixed infra + lower unit cost. I'll loop in pricing.

kevin (Solutions Eng): Perf tradeoffs: quant reduces cost but can add latency variance. If they need p99 latency tight, recommend Dedicated with latency-optimized GPU profile. We can run a short bench.

anya (AE): Action items: Samir prepare 2-option proposal (Hosted EU + gateway pattern vs Dedicated EU with STS+KMS). Kevin add Go WS + helper lib. Lucy attach SOC2 attestation and KMS checklist.
